name: a-muted-video-stays-in-its-tab
description: Of the auto mini player: under autoMiniPlayer 'audible' a muted video is not worth a mini player, so leaving its tab leaves it where it is. Same page, same switch and same probe as a-video-tab-pops-out-when-you-leave-it, with the one difference the setting reads - the video carries `muted`. A scenario cannot prove a negative by waiting, so this settles for longer than the sibling took and reads once.

actions.note: the command bar, because restore refuses a file:// row (rust/atrium-core/src/restore.rs scheme_allowed) so the page cannot come from the spaces fixture
first, because it also warms the debugging tunnel the eval_until below would otherwise spend its whole budget on
a later 'in-tab' must mean the gate refused, not that the video never started
previousTab, the tab switch away - cmd+shift+left is previousSPACE and changes no tab at all

assertions.desc: the video really is playing, and muted, before the switch
nothing has popped out while the tab is still the active one
Of the auto mini player: nothing popped out
